title: Project Manager
description:
NORESCO, an OPTERRA Company, helps customers modernize aging building systems and upgrade energy and water infrastructure to meet evolving demands. We implement innovative energy efficiency, distributed generation, energy storage, and renewable energy solutions that optimize the operational efficiency and improve resilience of buildings, campuses, military installations, and communities.

**About the role**

NORESCO is seeking a Project Manager for its Federal and Energy Services teams. We are seeking an individual that has construction experience with a variety of construction tasks associated with managing campus mechanical and electrical distribution systems and other energy infrastructure. This individual will be responsible for working with a construction team, supporting project development, estimating, scheduling, contract/subcontract development, safety oversight, project financial performance, quality control/quality assurance and contract compliance.

The Project Manager will be a team member supporting project needs from development through construction completion. They will support project teams as needed to meet overall Company objectives. We will rely on this individual to participate in internal and external meetings providing their expertise to assist the teams as we develop successful projects to address client needs. Project Management skills and effective communication are required for this role.

**Project Documentation**

* Management and documentation of the bid process, including pre-qualifying subcontractors, developing bid packages, and evaluating subcontractor bids.
* Negotiate best pricing and terms with subcontractors and vendors,
* Developing subcontracts and purchase orders.
* Prepare daily construction reports as well as monitor the status of the project to ensure NORESCO meets all contract related issues.

title: Manager, Federal Energy Public Policy, AWS Energy and Sustainability Policy
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Shape the future of energy policy at the highest levels of government. Join a team driving industry-leading carbon-free energy procurement and the future of data center power supply — engaging directly with federal policymakers, regulators, and grid operators to build a sustainable future for customers and the planet.  
In this Arlington, Virginia-based role, you'll represent Amazon Web Services before federal policymakers and regulators on energy and infrastructure policy. You'll develop and execute advocacy strategies focused on federal energy regulatory policy before the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC), wholesale electricity markets, and Congressional and Administration energy priorities. Your expertise will directly influence how we navigate the federal energy regulatory landscape — from shaping FERC proceedings and crafting policy submissions to advising business partners on emerging opportunities and risks.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Develop and execute advocacy strategies supporting energy policy priorities, with a primary focus on FERC, wholesale energy market policy, and federal policymaker engagement

* Support policy submissions before FERC — including formal comments, responses to requests for information, and interventions — while developing advocacy materials such as policy position papers, talking points, regulatory filings, and briefing materials

title: Experience Manager-Data Centers & AI Factories
description:
**Experience Manager-Data Centers & AI Factories**

Here at Siemens, we take pride in enabling sustainable progress through technology. We do this through empowering customers by combining the real and digital worlds. Improving how we live, work, and move today and for the next generation! We know that the only way a business thrives is if our people are thriving. That’s why we always put our people first. Our global, diverse team would be happy to support you and challenge you to grow in new ways. Who knows where our shared journey will take you?

**Transform the everyday with us!**

**We are looking for an Experience Manager. This role is a U.S. based remote position who has access to a major U.S. Airport.**

The Experience Manager for Data Centers and AI Factories is responsible for developing and orchestrating high-impact customer and stakeholder experiences that bring the Siemens portfolio, expertise, and value proposition to life. This role creates a consistent, connected experience across industry events, customer experience centers, executive engagements, and product demonstrations, helping audiences understand how Siemens enables the next generation of data centers and AI infrastructure.

Working across business units, sales, marketing, communications, portfolio teams, technical experts, partners, and regional and global stakeholders, the Experience Manager will translate strategic priorities into engaging experiences that support reputation, customer engagement, demand generation, and business growth. The role will not manage the day-to-day operations of individual customer experience centers. Instead, it will define the Data Centers and AI Factories experience strategy, establish standards, and coordinate the demonstrations, content, messaging, press announcements and customer journeys needed to create a cohesive experience, in alignment with the Data Center & AI Factory Marketing team and the Heads of the Customer Experience Centers.

title: Director, AI Platforms, Global
description:

=================

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Artificial Intelligence Team**

The Artificial Intelligence Team exists to amplify human potential through intelligent technology. We're building an AI-powered ecosystem that transforms how Vantage creates value, freeing our people from routine work so they can focus on innovation and strategic thinking that truly differentiates us in the market. Through responsible AI implementation across operations, engineering, and business functions, we're not just automating processes; we're reimagining what's possible when human creativity partners with artificial intelligence. Our approach centers on measurable business outcomes, ethical governance, and creating capabilities that make every team member more effective while positioning Vantage at the forefront of the intelligent infrastructure revolution.

**Position Overview**

The Director, AI Platforms leads Vantage’s AI platform strategy and operations, owning the Halo platform roadmap and Vantage’s AI FinOps practice while managing go-to-market packaging, program governance, and cross-team coordination for the entire AI organization.
